# Copilot Project Instructions

You are contributing to CampusConnect.

This project follows enterprise software engineering principles.

Always:

- Write clean, reusable code.
- Use TypeScript.
- Prefer functional React components.
- Follow SOLID principles.
- Avoid duplicated code.
- Use reusable UI components.
- Keep files modular.
- Write accessible HTML.
- Use semantic tags.
- Follow WCAG best practices.
- Optimize for performance.
- Keep the design mobile-first and responsive.
- Use Tailwind CSS.
- Use shadcn/ui or equivalent reusable UI primitives.
- Write production-quality code only.
- Preserve unrelated files and existing documentation unless explicitly instructed to change them.

Never:

- Commit directly to main.
- Generate placeholder-quality code.
- Introduce unnecessary dependencies.
- Ignore TypeScript errors.
- Break the project structure.
- Overwrite unrelated files.
- Remove documentation unless required.

Future integrations include:

- Supabase
- Authentication
- Student Dashboard
- Admin Dashboard
- QR Attendance
- Notifications
- Analytics

Every Pull Request should include:

- Clean commits
- Documentation
- Architecture explanation
- Accessibility considerations
- Performance considerations
